name: protokuda
description: A Star Trek-ish stylesheet: what Michael Okuda might have drawn on his way to LCARS.
author: Dennis Dunn <ansofive@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/themes && cd docs/styles && cat tokens.css colors.css body.css controls.css frame.css screen.css > ../../dist/protokuda.css && cd ../.. && cp docs/themes/*.css dist/themes
